details: CONFIRMED. Routes, PythonStep and BrokenAndMissing subclass InstallScript for its helpers, so every test method defined on InstallScript runs
in each of them with identical setup (their overrides do not touch the folder lookup). Project principle 2: waste that repeats on every run
is MEDIUM. Cost is small (about 0.3 s per run), but the rule sets no threshold. The two older InstallScript tests have the same problem; that
predates the change and is F2 (outside). Size: 5 minutes.
evidence: grep -n '^class ' tests/test_installer_doctor.py -> class Routes(InstallScript), class PythonStep(InstallScript), class BrokenAndMissing(InstallScript)
failing_case: pytest tests/test_installer_doctor.py -k RELAY_ROOT --collect-only collects 4 tests (InstallScript, Routes, PythonStep, BrokenAndMissing),
each running install.sh twice with the same input; it should collect 1.
fix_hint: Move the test into its own class derived from Fakes (e.g. class CodeFolder(Fakes)), or into a class no other class inherits.
pass_cases: 1. pytest tests/test_installer_doctor.py -k RELAY_ROOT --collect-only -> exactly 1 test collected.
2. That one test still fails on the merge base install.sh (RELAY_HOME at a folder with deps.toml -> exit 0 there, asserted 1).
3. That one test passes on HEAD: RELAY_HOME -> exit 1, stderr has "deps.toml not found" and "RELAY_ROOT"; RELAY_ROOT -> exit 0.
reason: tests/test_installer_doctor.py:209 class CodeFolder(Fakes), not inherited; collect-only shows one RELAY_ROOT test. Passes on head, fails at pre-fix commit with this test file copied in.
findings.summary: principle 2 (waste): the new test sits in InstallScript, which three classes inherit, so it runs 4 times per gate

details: PLAUSIBLE as a breach: the source does use $HOME plus a relative path, which may be all the owner meant (no hard-coded folder), and printing
the folder actually searched helps. Read strictly ("in any message ... you touch"), the person reads two absolute paths. LOW: cheap either
way; the owner's reading decides. Size: 5 minutes.
evidence: install.sh:26 echo "... or in $root; put the relay folder at $HOME/relay first (or set RELAY_ROOT)" inside double quotes, so both expand.
failing_case: HOME=/Users/x, RELAY_ROOT unset, install.sh copied to a folder without deps.toml: stderr is
"install.sh: deps.toml not found next to this script or in /Users/x/relay; put the relay folder at /Users/x/relay first (or set RELAY_ROOT)".
Under the owner's 26 Oct decision ("не используй прямой путь, опирайся на относительный путь + переменную окружения") the hint would read
"put the relay folder at $HOME/relay first (or set RELAY_ROOT)" literally.
fix_hint: Escape the hint: ... put the relay folder at \$HOME/relay first (or set RELAY_ROOT). Keep "$root" expanded or write \$RELAY_ROOT.
pass_cases: 1. RELAY_ROOT unset, no deps.toml: stderr contains the literal text "$HOME/relay" and "RELAY_ROOT".
3. RELAY_HOME=<tmp>/code holding deps.toml, RELAY_ROOT unset: exit 1, stderr names RELAY_ROOT (unchanged).
reason: install.sh:26 still expands  and /Users/amidman in double quotes (absolute paths printed). LOW, so not open; the source uses variable plus relative path.
findings.summary: the touched error message prints absolute paths ($root and $HOME expand), where the owner asked for variable plus relative path
